question: Estimate the per-km cost of building a 4-lane National Highway in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Construction cost only (excluding land acquisition)? Yes — civil construction.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: 4-lane highway construction cost: ~₹18-25 crore per km (depending on terrain).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total all-in (incl. land) for plain-terrain 4-lane: ~₹22-30 cr/km.

calculationFlow: 4-lane highway construction cost: ~₹18-25 crore per km (depending on terrain).
Plus land acquisition (separate): ~₹3-15 cr/km (highly variable by location).
Total all-in (incl. land) for plain-terrain 4-lane: ~₹22-30 cr/km.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total all-in (incl. land) for plain-terrain 4-lane: ~₹22-30 cr/km.
